inclusion_criteria.description: Severe chronic knee pain affecting activities of daily living for > 6 months
Radiographic evidence of severe joint space narrowing or Kellgren-Lawrence Grade 3-4 osteoarthritis
Completion of at least 12 weeks of non-operative conservative therapy (Physical Therapy, NSAIDs, intra-articular injections)

exclusion_criteria: Active systemic or local joint infection
Severe neurovascular impairment in affected limb
required_documentation: Weight-bearing knee X-ray report (< 90 days old)

inclusion_criteria.description: Low back pain with radiculopathy (sciatica) persisting > 6 weeks
Failed minimum 6 weeks of conservative management (PT, chiropractic, or anti-inflammatory regimen)
Objective neurological deficit documented on physical exam (motor weakness, sensory loss, or diminished reflexes)

exclusion_criteria: Uncomplicated low back pain < 6 weeks duration without red flag symptoms
required_documentation: Physician physical exam with neurological evaluation

inclusion_criteria.description: Abnormal non-invasive cardiac stress test (nuclear, echo, or stress ECG) showing moderate to severe ischemia
Unstable angina or refractory angina pectoris despite maximal medical therapy
Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < 50% with suspected ischemic etiology

exclusion_criteria: Severe acute renal failure (CrCl < 15 mL/min) without planned hemodialysis setup
required_documentation: Cardiac Stress Test or Echocardiogram final report
